meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或评估合并请求的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or assess pull request impact

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析 Git 代码变更，找出修改的文件、受影响的组件和风险，并生成结构化报告。
howto.when: 当你需要理解代码变更的影响时，例如在代码审查或合并请求中。

say.text: 分析当前分支的未提交变更。
say.note: Claude 会执行 git diff 并生成影响分析。

say.text: 对比 main 分支，分析我的功能分支的变更。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes Git diffs to identify changed files, affected components, and risks, producing a structured report.
howto.when_en: When you need to understand the impact of code changes, such as during code review or pull requests.

say_en.text: Analyze uncommitted changes on the current branch.
say_en.note: Claude runs git diff and generates impact analysis.

say_en.text: Compare my feature branch against main.
say_en.note: Claude runs git diff main...HEAD and analyzes.
